blind.label: The fear spell that promised confusion
blind.explanation: A level fifty necromancer stands surrounded by four young red dragons and considers its blind-creature maneuver, which casts Frighten. The original scored the cast with the confusion attack type: the borg danger model suppresses a confused dragon massively (the probe records a confusion delta of four hundred eight against a fear delta of zero), so the maneuver was valued at nine hundred fifty-five - a phantom the spell cannot deliver, and high enough to win the chooser. The correction scores the cast as the fear effect it is: the maneuver values minus five, exactly what the dedicated Frighten maneuver values.
